title: Framework's Data Breach Revealed Customer Data: Here's What to Know - CNET
summary: Framework, a company best known for producing modular, highly repairable and customizable PCs and laptops, has suffered a large data breach, which has compromised customer information, according to multiple media outlets and an email from the company that has been shared online.
